Name: Ramah in Simeon
ModernLocation: Unknown; in Simeon's allotment (proposed sites include Tel Ira)
Description: The Ramath named in Simeon's town list, identified with Baalath-beer, distinct from the Ramahs of Benjamin, Asher, and Naphtali.
BiblicalSignificance: Ramah in Simeon is a Simeonite town name preserved in the allotment lists.
